04 / Character reference matrix

Decoded characters flash their matching cell. A space is inserted after a longer pause between characters; use the word-gap button below to separate words.

05 / Recorder

Record mode stores key-down and key-up timing, decoded characters, and pauses. Playback replays the key rhythm and visual feedback.
